source_text: It also lets you want suffering to end without that wish turning into desperation or fear of failure.

context.preceding:
I realized it doesn’t help to spread negativity just because misery loves company. I’ve been preaching metta ever since 😊❣. Still trying to realize that deeper tho!
In the Metta Sutta, you wish ease and happiness to beings, yourself included. Metta calms the hindrances and builds goodwill.
context.following: Theravada and most Mahayana Buddhist traditions treat metta as essential groundwork before the deeper work of unweaving the sense streams that make up the mind.

direct_owner.meaning: Mettā is a wish of goodwill for suffering to end, as opposed to demanding or forcing that result. When the wish becomes an achievement project it can bring desperation and fear of failure.
